title: This Metroid waited 16 years
caption: Metroid Dread was first planned around 2005 and shelved twice before launching in 2021. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #metroid #metroiddread

instagram.caption:
Metroid Dread was first planned for the Nintendo DS around 2005. Fans spotted the name on a list and waited for years.

Producer Yoshio Sakamoto said the hardware could not deliver his vision, so it was shelved twice.

In 2021 it finally launched on Switch and became the best-selling 2D Metroid. Sometimes waiting is worth it.
